purpose: Operational distinction between directed accuracy of restatement and content agreement; not a measure of conscious experience or moral truth.
scope: Two voluntary adults, same prespecified 0..4 response items; equal item weighting and equal category spacing are assumptions.

definitions.items: m >= 1, fixed and anchored before and after
definitions.reporting: Report both directed values separately, with item-level detail; never merge into human ranking.
definitions.before_after: Use identical anchored questions. Withhold change in a directed accuracy if any of its reference answers changed. Report agreement change separately.

formal_result.claim: Perfect restatement accuracy and maximal disagreement can coexist; maximal agreement and inaccurate restatements can coexist.

hypothesis.claim: Reciprocal restatement with permission to correct improves both directed accuracy measures relative to a time-matched neutral discussion; change in agreement is not required.
hypothesis.disconfirmation: No improvement, reversal, systematic harms or failure under a pre-registered comparison.

limits: Not suitable for abuse mediation or ranking people
